title: Travel App Steps and Calm Clarity Sections
whatItIs: A cropped travel landing page: a lavender section with four numbered step cards beside a phone over swirling clouds, then a white section with the headline 'An app Designed for calmness and clarity' with a circled word, an Explore all Features button and three phone tiles.
whatItMeans: Icon steps beside a cloud-backed phone explain the flow, and the circled word adds a human touch.
techniques: Phone in front of stylised clouds
Hand-drawn double ellipse around a word

vocabulary.definition: A card with an icon, title and short description of one step.
Stylised clouds used behind a phone.
Panels each holding a phone screen.
